description: This file contains unit tests for IPC (Inter-Process Communication) mechanisms in the Rialto project, specifically testing client connection, state management, ping, configuration, and event forwarding functionalities.

methods.name: PerformSetStateShouldReturnFalseWhenNoAppIsConnected
methods.description: Tests that setting the session server state returns false when no application is connected.

methods.name: PerformPingShouldReturnFalseWhenNoAppIsConnected
methods.description: Tests that performing a ping returns false when no application is connected.

methods.name: ShouldFailToCreateClientWhenServerIsNotRunning
methods.description: Tests that client creation fails when the server is not running.

methods.name: ShouldConnectToRialtoSessionServer
methods.description: Tests successful connection to the Rialto session server.

methods.name: ShouldFailToConnectToTheSameAppTwice
methods.description: Ensures that attempting to connect the same app twice fails.

methods.name: ShouldRemoveClient
methods.description: Tests that removing a client causes subsequent state change attempts to fail.

methods.name: ShouldSuccessfullySetState
methods.description: Tests successful setting of session server state.

methods.name: ShouldFailToSetStateWhenFailResponseIsReceived
methods.description: Tests that setting state fails when a fail response is received.

methods.name: ShouldSuccessfullyPing
methods.description: Tests successful ping after client connection.

methods.name: ShouldFailToPingWhenFailResponseIsReceived
methods.description: Tests that ping fails when a fail response is received.

methods.name: ShouldForwardStateChangedIndicationToSessionServerAppManager
methods.description: Verifies that state change indications are forwarded to the app manager.

methods.name: ShouldForwardAckEventToSessionServerAppManager
methods.description: Verifies that acknowledgment events are forwarded appropriately.

methods.name: ShouldForwardNotRunningStateChangeToSessionServerAppManagerWhenUnexpectedlyDisconnected
methods.description: Ensures that a not-running state change is forwarded when the client disconnects unexpectedly.

methods.name: ShouldSuccessfullySetLogLevels
methods.description: Tests successful setting of log levels.

methods.name: ShouldFailToSetLogLevels
methods.description: Tests failure to set log levels when server responds with failure.

methods.name: ShouldFailToSetConfiguration
methods.description: Tests failure to set configuration when server responds with failure.
